name: Acts Of Kindness
overview: Scripture calls believers to demonstrate genuine love and kindness, even to those who oppose them, as Jesus commands loving enemies and doing good to those who hate us (Luke 6:27). This love is sacrificial and self-giving, modeled by Christ laying down His life for His friends (John 15:13) and expressed through brotherly affection and honoring one another (Romans 12:10). Acts of kindness are also linked to generosity, with the promise that giving results in abundant blessing (Luke 6:38) and the encouragement that it is more blessed to give than to receive (Acts 20:35). Above all, the new commandment to love one another as Christ loved us (John 13:34) grounds all acts of kindness in His example and teaching.
